subject: Geopolitics
title: Conspiracy Theories as Weapons
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Conspiracy Theories as Weapons.

hook.text: QAnon started as anonymous internet posts. Within years, its followers stormed the US Capitol. Fiction became physical.

buildup.text: Conspiracy theories simplify complex realities into hero-villain stories. They offer certainty in confusing times.

discovery.text: States weaponize conspiracies: Russia promoted anti-vaccine theories in the West.

twist.text: Once planted, conspiracies self-replicate. Believers become missionaries.

climax.text: Conspiracy theories are low-cost, high-impact weapons.

punchline.text: Plant a seed of doubt. Watch a society crack.

quiz.question: Why are conspiracy theories effective as information weapons?
options: They require massive budgets to spread
Believers spread them voluntarily, requiring no further effort
